sections.heading: Behind The Lock
sections.text:
- 3x Medcase
- Loose Medical supplies on shelves and tables
- Black keycard spawn location on the table next to the computer
- Possible LEDX Skin Transilluminator in the metal containers
- Possible Intelligence folder and TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials spawn near the laptop
- Possible Intelligence folder and TerraGroup "Blue Folders" materials spawn on the shelf next to the door to the side room
- 2x Weapon box (4x4)
- Loose Weapon mods and Ammunition on the shelf
- A possible Weapons spawn on the front desk
